## About the Event

POTENZIAis a National level students’ Annual Technical Fest organized by the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering. It is a blend of technical events such as a training program for students, paper presentation, poster presentation, working model, technical quiz, etc., which explores the potential of students both in conducting and in participating in events. POTENZIA is a platform for students to realize their team coordination and organizing skills, and brings them all to one place to showcase their technical abilities to excel in their careers.
